# User block list

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P1 · Who did it](../README.md#phase-1--who-did-it) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:user-block-list` · **Epic:** [#46](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/46) · **Tickets:** 3 (1S 2M)

Admins can block a person by Dex sub or email from the console. The list ships to workers inside the policy wire type as `blockedUsers`, and workers deny any request whose verified identity matches, within one long-poll cycle. This is the P1 offboarding and incident kill switch.

## How we build it

- cpstate table `blocked_users(id, sub, email, reason, created_by, created_at)`, with at least one of sub/email required. It is not part of policy versions, so rollback never unblocks anyone.
- Wire: `policyWire.BlockedUsers []config.BlockedUser json:"blockedUsers,omitempty"` with `{sub, email}` only (reason stays on the CP). It is also added to `config.Policy` (json `blockedUsers`) and to the worker `remoteWire` decode. The ETag covers it automatically.
- Worker match: sub exact match, or email case-insensitive match against the verified identity. Checked at CONNECT when Proxy-Authorization identity is present, and again for each request in the new identity stage, so kept-alive TLS sessions are cut on the next request.
- Deny response: `403` with JSON `{"error":"user_blocked"}`. The event has Decision=deny and Reason=`user_blocked`, the metric `RecordBlocked("user_blocked")` fires, and a Finding is published through the CP alert pipeline via the existing event bridge.
- Standalone (local-only) workers accept `policy.blockedUsers` in local YAML for parity.

## Done when

An admin blocks alice@corp, and within one long-poll cycle her next request (new CONNECT or an existing kept-alive session) gets 403 user_blocked while other users are unaffected. Unblocking restores access.

### 1/3 · W-P1-BLOCK-01

**Carry blockedUsers in the policy wire and config.Policy**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#47](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/47)

Add `config.BlockedUser{Sub, Email}` and `Policy.BlockedUsers` (yaml `policy.blockedUsers`, json `blockedUsers`). Normalize emails to lowercase and validate that each entry has sub or email. Add `BlockedUsers` to `controlplane.policyWire` with omitempty, so a CP with no blocks stays byte-identical. Update `parseRemotePolicy` so workers decode it.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] With an empty list, /policy JSON is byte-identical to before (golden test)
- [ ] A worker RemoteProvider round-trips blockedUsers and an entry with neither field fails validation

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-BLOCK-02`](user-block-list.md#23--w-p1-block-02) Enforce block list in the worker at CONNECT and per request; [`W-P1-BLOCK-03`](user-block-list.md#33--w-p1-block-03) Add CP block-list store, admin API and dashboard UI

### 2/3 · W-P1-BLOCK-02

**Enforce block list in the worker at CONNECT and per request**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#48](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/48)

Add a `BlockList` snapshot (sub set + lowercase email set) to `internal/proxy`, hot-swapped by the worker applier when policy changes. Check it in `handleConn` after CONNECT identity extraction and in the identity request stage before `judgeGate`. On a match, write `403` with JSON `{"error":"user_blocked"}`, store a deny event with Reason `user_blocked` and the user fields, and close the session. Requests without identity are not affected (attribute mode).

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] A test with a blocked sub over CONNECT gets 403 and no upstream dial happens
- [ ] A kept-alive TLS session gets 403 on the first request after the list update
- [ ] The deny event carries user_sub and reason=user_blocked

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-BLOCK-01`](user-block-list.md#13--w-p1-block-01) Carry blockedUsers in the policy wire and config.Policy; [`W-P1-VRFY-02`](identity-verification.md#25--w-p1-vrfy-02) Extract, verify and strip identity on CONNECT and requests

### 3/3 · W-P1-BLOCK-03

**Add CP block-list store, admin API and dashboard UI**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#49](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/49)

Add the `blocked_users` migration and store, plus `GET/POST /dashboard/api/blocked-users` and `DELETE /dashboard/api/blocked-users/{id}` (admin). `policyServer` merges the list into the served wire and refreshes on change. Add a 'Blocked users' panel with add (sub or email + reason) and remove, and make each user row in the traffic view link to 'block this user'. Each change goes through the admin audit middleware with target `blocked_users`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] POST adds an entry, wakes long-poll waiters, and the next /policy includes it
- [ ] An editor gets 403 and an admin succeeds, and both cases produce audit rows
- [ ] Removing the entry restores the previous ETag

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-BLOCK-01`](user-block-list.md#13--w-p1-block-01) Carry blockedUsers in the policy wire and config.Policy; [`W-P1-SSO-05`](console-sso-rbac.md#56--w-p1-sso-05) Map groups to roles and enforce role checks on dashboard APIs; [`W-P1-AAUD-02`](admin-audit-log.md#23--w-p1-aaud-02) Record every CP mutation via audit middleware with state hashers
